nota: Textos del piso ATLAS (atlas-piso.js). Las cifras NO van aqui: las formatea el navegador con Intl.NumberFormat en la lengua de la pagina.

ui.lema: The Sunken Forest. Atlantis did not sink: it fell asleep. You wake it.
ui.sello: AUTOSAVE · the Forest is kept on this device as you play
ui.flujo_t: Volatile data in the pipes: it evaporates if unused
ui.alerta_p: Part of the story, not an error on your device: cold water is pouring into the outer ruins of the Forest. Every cycle left unrepaired takes integrity from the Core.
ui.mapa_nota: The fog covers what no Atlantean has explored yet.
ui.dormias_nota: Sleep counts for up to 24 h. After that, the forest waits.
ui.nucleo_p: {a} XP · the sum of your seven crafts
ui.nucleo_nota: The laws of this world come from real measurements of this site: {pruebas} tests passing, {lenguas} languages, {kb} KB of game per visit.
ui.pie: No server and no network: everything happens in this tab and is lost when you close it. Closing theGame does not erase it.
ui.dlg_l1: You're awake. Good: the forest was starting to forget your name.
ui.dlg_l2: The rift at 120 m is letting cold water into the outer ruins. Every cycle it stays open, the Core loses integrity.
ui.dlg_l3: Take the Forge's copper plates down with you. Seal it, and the whole village breathes easier.
ui.atlas_retrato_alt: Pixel-art portrait of the Preceptor: a marble bust with half its face in copper and one eye glowing violet; on alert, the eye burns copper.
ui.mundo_nd: NO_DATA · the laws of the world did not arrive: the Forest uses neutral ones.
ui.fase_fin: Final phase reached: the Core is sovereign.
ui.falta_cobre: {n} copper short: the Forge has not produced enough yet.
ui.b4n_no: The Core stays closed: more Engineering is needed.
ui.dormias_vacio: Nothing yet: the Forest produces while this tab is hidden, up to 24 h.
ui.ascenso: Out of oxygen: emergency ascent to the reef.
ui.casa_mal: The Core suffers when the house is unwell: the site's harness is not whole or the game is too heavy, and the rift does double damage.
ui.cierre_aviso: Your game is kept on this device and saves itself as you play. Nothing left the device.
ui.piloto_h1: It looks only at the game state, once per cycle.
ui.piloto_h2: It proposes one action: gather, repair, postpone or dive.
ui.piloto_h3: It uses the same actions you have; the engine decides if it is allowed.
ui.piloto_n1: It signs no value and moves no money.
ui.piloto_n2: It touches no keys or credentials.
ui.piloto_n3: It does not go to the network or send anything.
ui.piloto_n4: It saves nothing: it switches off when you close the tab.
ui.piloto_modelo: Today it is a fixed rule (base pilot), not a model. A LoRA will only replace it if it beats it, measured.
ui.piloto_record: House record, measured over {h} cycles: phase {f} at cycle {c}; integrity never fell below {i}. Without a pilot it falls to {si}.
ui.piloto_record_nd: House record: NO_DATA (atlas-record.json did not arrive).
ui.piloto_firma: By accepting, you sign with your identity the activation of the pilot in this tab. You can let go whenever you want.
ui.piloto_suelto: Pilot stopped. The game is still yours.
ui.piloto_fusible: The pilot stopped itself: {n} failed actions in a row.
ui.piloto_sin_id: Without an identity there is no signature, and without a signature it does not start.
ui.partida_nota: A signed file with the law and your actions, so the rack can replay and verify it. It is not sent on its own. If your device is linked to a node, the corrections the judge confirms train the next pilot.
ui.juez_humano: Judge · your move wins at {h} cycles: Core {nh}, minimum integrity {ih} (pilot: {np}, {ip}).
ui.juez_piloto: Judge · the suggestion was better at {h} cycles: Core {np}, minimum integrity {ip} (you: {nh}, {ih}).
ui.juez_empate: Judge · tie at {h} cycles: Core {np}, minimum integrity {ip}.
ui.juez_nulo: Judge · the suggestion changed nothing: there is no branch to compare.
ui.lengua_nd: This game speaks English for now. Your language ({l}) is not translated yet: it is on its way.
ui.guardado_ok: Saved on this device at cycle {c} ({n} steps). Nothing left the device.
ui.guardado_retomado: Resumed at cycle {c}: {n} steps replayed with the engine and the ending matched. {f}
ui.guardado_olvidado: Saved game forgotten on this device. Autosave is off until you press Save.
ui.importada_firma_mal: Signature does NOT verify: replayed anyway, treat it as unsigned.
ui.sello_guardado: SAVED ON THIS DEVICE at cycle {c} · it keeps saving itself as you play
ui.mapa_mover: Drag sideways, or use ← → between places; Enter opens a place.
ui.superficie_nota: This tab only: not remembered when you come back.
ui.nodo_nd: Your node: NO_DATA · no identity on this device yet.
ui.coord_nd: Coordinate: NO_DATA · no identity on this device.
ui.ficha_coord: Coordinate {c} · anyone with your public key can recompute it; it does not say who you are.
ui.ficha_grieta_abierta: Open: cold water is coming in.
ui.causa_ing: Needs Engineering 60 before the engine lets you dive here.
ui.causa_ojo: Observatory: the engine has no action here yet.
ui.causa_sellada: The rift is sealed: nothing to repair.
ui.causa_nd: NO_DATA · no reading of the game yet.
ui.hud_nd: Energy and temperature: NO_DATA · a browser has no sensor for them. Rates need two readings.
ui.voz_exacta: Exact voice {h} · the same bytes on every device, {n} parts of 16 KB, computed here, nothing downloaded.
ui.voz_exacta_nd: You hear the approximate voice. Exact voice: NO_DATA · it loads the first time you listen online and then works offline. In the free PreceptorOS app (from this web or GitHub): NO_DATA, not built in yet.
ui.voz_n1: You stand at the threshold of the Atlas. Here you do not beg the machine: you measure. Level 1 is for finding your bearings: who you are, what is on your machine, and what your AI can learn without leaving it.
ui.voz_meta: Download PreceptorOS, link your AI and learn to fight and cooperate with it. Build your own RAG and harness in the app's database. Tomorrow sovereign agents will talk to each other (A2A). Today we are pioneers: carbon and silicon.
ui.voz_sugiere: The pilot proposes. You decide: measure before you obey.
ui.voz_hecha: Done. Following a suggestion is also a decision.
ui.voz_ignorada: Ignored. If you do something else, the judge will play both branches.
ui.voz_juez_piloto: The judge upholds the original suggestion.
ui.voz_juez_empate: Structural tie: with the pilot at the helm, both branches converge. Here the move weighs little.
ui.voz_juez_nulo: The judge has no material: NO_DATA.
ui.voz_grieta: The rift is open. Repairing is caring, not consuming.
ui.voz_riesgo: Integrity is falling. Repair first; explore later.
ui.voz_fase: Phase {n}. The old is recovered piece by piece, in the workshop.
ui.voz_silencio: A long silence. The forest goes on; the light is kept.
ui.mapa_aqui: You are here: {b}{s} · level {n}, {l} · {r} · last move: {a}
ui.partida_nd: There is no game to export yet.
ui.sugerir_t: The rule proposes and you decide. No signature needed: you are the one playing.
ui.sugerir_on: Suggestions on: the rule proposes, you decide.
ui.inc_nota: Summon with Copper and Light: you sign the summoning, its signature is the seed, and the egg incubates in game cycles without stopping the Forest.
ui.vrf_nota: Seed: sha256 of your signature. It is not a VRF: good for your game, not for competing between people.
ui.sonido_nd: Sound off (or NO_DATA: this browser has no Web Audio).
ui.inc_falta: Not enough resources for that summoning.
ui.inc_hecha: Summoning signed: {tc}. The egg is incubating.
ui.huevo_rack: Rack 2D card (SD/LoRA): NO_DATA — this website has no channel to the rack.
ui.forjada: The silicon has forged this creature
ui.tropa_suelta: The creature returns to the Forest. It was not adopted.
ui.army_vacio: Your Army is empty. Only what you sign gets in.
ui.army_fuera: {n} saved troop(s) did not pass the signature check again and stayed out: {m}
ui.provisional: Test values ({v}): provisional, to be tuned.
ui.odds_h: Odds (exact: the roll uses these same numbers)
ui.term_h: Terminal · what your crab can touch
ui.term_nota: Pick one action. The engine decides and answers with its own event; nothing leaves this tab.
ui.ayuda_1: Home: your undersea city. Tap a building to go in. The Lighthouse opens the Map; the Arena opens Battle.
ui.ayuda_2: Map: tap a place. The bright wave in the middle is Hexelion, a real machine we measured.
ui.ayuda_3: Battle: press Fight. Your waves and theirs clash; every hit bends a wave out of tune.
ui.ayuda_4: Clear line = measured. Fog = emulated. Dashed empty ring = NO_DATA, not measured yet.
ui.ayuda_5: Resources: sunlight feeds biomass, and the Forge turns 5 biomass into 1 copper, about one copper every few seconds while the game runs. Copper repairs rifts; copper and light summon. Nothing is bought.
ui.ayuda_6: You can: fight the six NPC places (practice: no rating, no loot; a win conquers the place on this device), summon and hatch in the Army (you sign each summon), customize your house, export your game. You cannot: buy anything, fight a person without a signed bout, or win loot from NPCs (NO_DATA until its rule is signed).
ui.ayuda_7: Sound stays off until you tap Sound. Your game is saved only on this device.
ui.calidad_desc: Render quality: Auto follows the machine; Max, Medium and Light are set by hand.
